subject: CYCLE-2 FINDING: generation-fenced refresh lease contract survives 8 adversarial sequences
body: Research-only abstract state-machine harness passed 8/8 adversarial cases: supported 120Hz; request-not-honored 60Hz fallback; unsupported-mode fallback; terminal before confirmation with late callback fencing; supersession generation fencing; native handoff release; confirmed 120Hz unable to create semantic readiness; and 60Hz fallback unable to block semantic readiness. This validates an implementable contract shape, not current app implementation or device delivery. Required production proof remains requested-vs-actual cadence plus release/post-release telemetry on physical Fold7.
